Easy SEO hack.

Go to Google Search Console.

Go to Performance, Search results.

Add filter.

Click Query.

Change  to Custom (regex). 

Take this: ^(?:\S+\s+){7,}\S+$

Paste it in.

Click Apply.

“These are long, specific questions people Google before they find you. It’s the same kind of questions they ask ChatGPT.

Pick ones with high impressions and low clicks.

Answer them at the top of your page that already ranks.”
From @askOkara

So if you click on one of these keywords, it shows you the pages that are ranking for the keyword. All you do is you go to your page and add in your desired keyword at the top.

Then you rank for more high volume keywords.

And you can get more amazing Google Search Console filters by clicking on the blue button within GSC. It’s an AI chat that makes your filters with natural language.
